candidates.reason: Basically the original scaled down. The text block starts at x≈160, leaving a dead strip of empty space on the left. The headline still wraps to two lines on a short banner, the subcopy orphans 'kitchen.', and the logo, headline and subcopy are crammed vertically with tight top and bottom margins.

Single-line headline suits the banner and the logo/headline/subcopy stack reads well in order. But the centred text block sits in the left two-thirds with about 170px of empty left margin, while the can and circles are pushed to the right edge with the circle cropped, so the layout feels lopsided. The SOLSTICE label on the can is tiny.

Pixel-identical to candidate 2 and has the same flaws: an unused empty left area, the centred text block not anchored to the product, the can crowded against the right edge with the backdrop circle cropped, and a tiny label on the can.

The subcopy is split off from the headline and placed to the right of the can, so reading order is broken (headline → product → orphaned subcopy). The headline is jammed near the bottom edge with almost no margin. A circle dot collides with the start of the subcopy, and the small light grey subcopy is weak against the busy circle area.
